'''Dev Migensoh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. There he had a small shop, where he built and sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry.
